headline: CanCode phase five opens; youth chatbot safety
digest: ISED launched CanCode's fifth phase: $30M to reach 1.1 million students and train 76,000 teachers in digital skills, coding and AI, open to not-for-profits. This is the core federal funding line for the youth STEM outreach sector. Mila and ROOST piloted a suicide-prevention guardrail for youth-facing chatbots, and Alberta committed $50M to Amii.
